pages.text: Put on $(bold)any boots$() (leather, iron, gold, diamond or netherite — any work) and the wear-time clock starts.$(br2)After enough cumulative wear time, boots become $(bold)sweaty$(): renamed to "X's sweaty boots" and you gain the $(bold)Sweaty Feet$() effect.

The threshold is set by the server config $(bold)level_1_seconds$() (30 s by default).$(br2)Once boots are sweaty, their level is baked in: $(bold)taking them off and re-wearing keeps the level$() — it only ever goes up.
